title: 2026 F-gas refillable-container sales and take-back QA

sources.title: Bans on F gas in new products and equipment: current and future
Selling F gas in cylinders or equipment

facts.source_fact: F gas used to service, maintain or fill RACHP equipment must be sold in refillable containers.
The refillable-container duty also covers F gas for fire-protection systems.
The duty also covers F gas for switchgear.
The duty also covers F gas used as a solvent.
A container is only classed as refillable if customers can return it for refilling.
Sellers must take back containers from customers to refill them.
Cylinder sales guidance independently states that F-gas cylinders must be refillable.
Refillable-container compliance is distinct from customer qualification checks.
Container status is distinct from whether the gas itself is subject to a servicing/refill ban.
facts.expected_handling: Keep container and gas-use gates separate.

facts.source_fact: Container compliance does not quantify F-gas emissions.
